Construction spend stood at INR 57.8 crores during Q1FY27, up 47.2% year-on-year, reflecting continued progress across our ongoing projects.
Total income for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 50.3 crores, reflecting a growth of 63% year-on-year.
Growth & demand: Further, the new launches and additions of land Eldeco Housing and Industries Limited August 13, 2026 parcels during the quarter strengthened the future growth visibility for your company, providing a solid foundation for the remainder of FY27.
Collections stood at INR 131.2 crores, exhibiting a growth of 68% year-on-year.
On the new launch front, we successfully launched Eldeco Imperia Avenue and achieved sales of 44 units with a booking value of approximately INR 14.6 crores.

The Profit After Tax came in at INR 15.1 crores, up 382% year-on-year and a PAT margin of 30.0%.
